headline: Broward, meet your next men’s pro team
caption:
Fort Lauderdale United joins USL League One in spring 2027. Home ground: Amerant Bank Field in Davie.

The women already play there. You can get to know the club before the men’s first season.

Who’s coming with you?

Club announcement: https://www.ftlutd.com/news/2026/09/30/fort-lauderdale-united-usl-league-one/
#BrowardSoccer #FortLauderdale #USLLeagueOne
altText: Cancha explains Fort Lauderdale United’s planned spring 2027 men’s USL League One debut. Real women’s club footage runs behind the graphics; it does not show the new men’s team.
footageSubject: Existing women’s club film; not the unlaunched men’s roster
